steps.name: A Respected Teacher (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Beinan] in 「Kali」, then find [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: So this is the tablet. Thank you.
(Beinan takes the tablet and examines it from every angle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does it bring anything back?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yes. That's right.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Before I was born into this body, I lived in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: And I followed her from Freios to Eastland...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: It must have been when the Kingdom of Mos crossed over to Eastland after its defeat in Freios...
(Beinan's eyes go vacant, losing their focus.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beinan? Snap out of it, Beinan!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lady Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Stand back, %s. Let me try.
(Medea takes a deep breath and taps Beinan's shoulder with her staff.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Come to your senses, Beinan.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No effect. I'm sorry, Beinan. Bear with me for a moment.
(Medea raises her staff again and swings it into Beinan's stomach.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Aaaah!! Beinan, why did you come flying all the way over here?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Beinan will be fine. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Will he really...?)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see you visited Lady Pasiphae.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, at Beinan's request.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, that reminds me of the child with the golem. Perhaps the one who came to see her was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I still don't know what Talos is planning, but it will affect that child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go check on her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please do... Meanwhile, I'll see what else we might be able to do with this tablet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll see you later, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, Beinan... Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: ...It had been so long, I let my guard down. In any case, I could clearly feel her influence in this tablet...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That is what she made it for.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Lady Medea, you feel different since you went away...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...I'm preparing for the 'night.' The day we face her. It may not be soon, but when the time comes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think I'll put other thoughts aside and read today. You should rest too, Beinan.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yes, understood.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I was just thinking of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? Why?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You helped me out before, and I felt bad that I hadn't thanked you properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What brings you here today?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone was worried about you, so I've come to see how you're doing.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I have to be, to keep living here. If it weren't for Madori and everyone else's help...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, may I ask something? This person who was worried about me... Do they look like me? Ears like these...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. She leads a tribe called the Kali on another continent.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Do you mean Lady Medea, the Champion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you know her name?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The professor told me about her. About people with far greater power than ordinary humans, who use it to protect others.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm grateful that someone like her would be concerned about me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, you've been to Knossos, haven't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know? I had something to do there recently.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Well, with what you said about her, and the person who visited me before... I had a feeling you might have been there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Please tell me about your visit to Knossos, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must be curious about it. I'll give you the short version...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly describe the sights you saw in Knossos to Narsha.)
(Narsha grows excited as she listens. Her sparkling eyes suggest something has caught her interest.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow, wow... Wooow!!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Golems? There are rocks shaped like golems?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I saw them there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's so excited. Maybe I could bring her something? While I'm there, I should ask Talos about her again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, would you like me to bring you something from Knossos?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What? Really?!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!!
(Narsha's eyes shine so brightly that it is almost impossible to look at her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think your eyes are about to shoot beams.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You're my hero, Teacher!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Teacher?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Teacher! You're wonderful! I'll be waiting!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Teacher, huh...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The president called for me, so I have to go. Take care, Teacher!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, back to Knossos, then? I'll talk to Talos first.)

steps.name: A Respected Teacher (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Minos] in 「Acro's Coffin」 and obtain the <Suspicious Electrical Cable>. Then turn in the quest to [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I told you to visit often, and now you're almost a nuisance. You really must...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really must tell you I'm not interested in you. I came because I have questions, so please just answer them.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hahaha. I did invite you to come often, so I can hardly complain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to ask you something, Talos...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: So I have nothing to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Last time he was mildly irritating. Now he's just plain infuriating...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Listen when someone's talking to you...!!)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What a shame. It would be more entertaining if you said your thoughts aloud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You flinch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Enough. What were you planning to do with that magic golem you tried to take?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Magic golem? I'm not sure what you mean.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: ...Was it him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that a man with animal ears left Knossos and came to the Guild Union.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And apart from Lord Minos, who can't get out, you're the only man with animal ears left in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Is that so? The great detective %s has arrived. But what will you do if it wasn't me?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I've heard enough. Stop.
(Talos covers the ears on top of his head with one hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Well, that's where his ears are, so of course he'd cover them there... But it's still irritating.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You seem to need something. Go see the Beastman King rampaging in there instead.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Keep him entertained for a while and he'll give you something worthwhile. He's a surprisingly troublesome fellow. Sigh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Sigh.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'm off, then. A flock of Aquila and Nakun came by and left their rubbish behind. I have cleaning to do.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Those creatures... All they do is make a fuss. Such a nuisance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's a keeper in a rather different sense of the word. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said to see Lord Minos. Let's head to Acro's Coffin.
(As soon as you enter Acro's Coffin, Minos approaches slowly, as though he has been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Your arrival tells me the goddess has answered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm afraid I haven't found a way for you and Lady Pasiphae to get out yet.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: That is all right. If it were easy, I would have broken out myself long ago.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I am grateful that you have returned at all.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: So, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Well, you see...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You may tell me. If it is within my power, I will help. The goddess gives her approval as well...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: (You can tell Lord Minos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris?)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: ...I hear the goddess' voice. Remarkable. In your presence, it grows clearer and clearer...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: As Medeia—Medea said, Eastland may be easy for her to reach, but Freios is not yet so.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: An ominous power, unlike that of a god, fills Freios and many other places...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You called Lady Medea... Medeia?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You did not know? Hmm... It is something of a childhood name. What Daphne used to call her.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: In any case, tell me why you have come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that a girl in a human town operates a magic golem, and that you are looking for something to give her.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: So one of the golems is with a girl in a human town...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: She probably looks like Pasiphae and me. If so, she would be one of our people.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I do not know how she came to live among humans or acquire that golem, but...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: In any case, %s, I have something you could give her...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Come at me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Attack me.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: If you desire something, pay a fitting price. If that price is merely a brief sparring match with me, should you not consider yourself fortunate?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I will wait at the far end of Acro's Coffin. Until then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Lord Minos?
(As soon as Minos finishes speaking, his figure disperses like an illusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those two really are a couple. They both say their piece and demand a fight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No choice, then. Better get going.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: That was enjoyable. Here, take this to the child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This looks like an electrical wire...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: In ancient times, we made this after studying one from a golem that fell from the sky. It is also called a cable, but we called it a Cord of the Mind.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It was what made the golems move...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I do not know what the child will do with it, but it should be of use.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Minos.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It was simply something I had. Now, return to her.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: And come visit again. That is how we will learn to trust one another.
(Minos looks satisfied.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It has only been a few days since I saw Pasiphae, yet I feel so restless. What could he fear so much that he would lock us away...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, Teacher! You're back?! I've been waiting!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm still not used to being called that... Anyway, here. I don't know if it'll help, but...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow! Wow!
(Eyes sparkling, Narsha accepts the electrical cable from %s.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The person who gave it to me said it was modeled on something from a golem that fell from the sky. A Cord of the Mind, he called it...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If I gather the parts and connect them with a cable like this, I think I could make something. I'll try it with Anise.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wait. A golem that fell from the sky? Could it be the one you fought, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm, this is tricky, Teacher... What did the person who gave you this look like?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Were they like me...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. He had ears like yours, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: ...I'd like to meet them when the time is right. The more I hear, the more I want to see them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure you will.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you for looking out for me, Teacher. Please tell me if there's ever anything you need. I'll find a way to help.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Something you're looking for might even turn up in the information on Madori and the golems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narsha. I'll be off, then.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Come to think of it, this might connect to the part Teacher found for me before. Let's try it!
